meta.title: dsh-connect-codearts
meta.description: Makes Huawei Cloud CodeArts (码道 / CodeArts Agent) models usable from DSH through a native adapter (third-party, unaffiliated) that speaks the gateway's own encrypted protocol — SDK-HMAC-SHA256 signing, P-256 key agreement, and SM4-GCM payloads — with no local bridge process and no occupied port. Configure it under Settings → 码道: one permanent AK/SK pair is exchanged for STS and renewed automatically, or the plugin borrows the local CodeArts client's sign-in. The model catalog is re-read from upstream every five minutes, so credit multipliers, context windows, and image support follow the gateway, and a read-only credit pill sits beside the composer.
